title: Coherent unit equations from associativity
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite coefficient extension E/Q_ell, schemes X,Y, and f:X→Y. Let F and μ be the coherent coefficient-sequence derived pullback and normalized tensor comparison of [def-pur-completed-pullback-tower-realizations]. Assume the usual associativity equation for μ on every triple of derived coefficient-sequence objects. Then there exists an isomorphism ε:F(1_Y)≅1_X such that, for every M, μ_(1,M);(ε⊗id);λ_(FM)=F(λ_M) and μ_(M,1);(id⊗ε);ρ_(FM)=F(ρ_M). Composition is in traversal order. The same ε satisfies both equations, without boundedness, constructibility, or invertibility assumptions.

source.place: Tags 03EL, 07A4 and 0941: the ring unit under pullback, and monoidal unit coherence from an associative invertible tensor comparison.

proof.text: Identify the chosen coherent tensor unit with the coefficient ring placed in degree zero. The reference closed symmetric monoidal structure has this unit description. The two tensor-right functors are left adjoint to the same internal-Hom functor; leftAdjointUniq at the reference unit, composed with the two unitors, gives the required identification. The sequence base-change functor is final. Mathlib pullbackObjUnitToUnit gives the ordinary pullback isomorphism for the ring unit, and exact derived pullback commutes with the single functor. Compose these isomorphisms to construct F(1_Y)≅1_X.

Convert the assumed tensorHom associativity equation to whiskering using id_tensorHom and tensorHom_id. Apply the already-proved generic unit_from_tensor theorem in FinitePullbackTensorUnitRepresentatives to F, μ and the constructed object isomorphism. That theorem obtains ε by full faithfulness of tensoring by F(1), normalizes the right unit equation at 1, and derives both universal unit equations from associativity, naturality and the triangle axiom. Package its two equations with the same ε.

theorem completedPullbackTensor_unit_of_associativity
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hA : ∀ M N P : coefficientSequenceDerived l E Y,
    (pullbackTensorSequenceDerived l E f).map
      ((pullbackTensorCalculus l E Y).systemClosed.monoidal.associator M N P).hom ≫
      (pullbackTensorSystemComparison l E f).hom.app
        (M,(pullbackTensorCalculus l E Y).systemClosed.tensor.obj (N,P)) ≫
      (pullbackTensorCalculus l E X).systemClosed.tensor.map
        (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 _) ((pullbackTensorSystemComparison l E f).hom.app (N,P))) =
    (pullbackTensorSystemComparison l E f).hom.app
      ((pullbackTensorCalculus l E Y).systemClosed.tensor.obj (M,N),P) ≫
      (pullbackTensorCalculus l E X).systemClosed.tensor.map
        (Prod.mkHom ((pullbackTensorSystemComparison l E f).hom.app (M,N)) (𝟙 _)) ≫
      ((pullbackTensorCalculus l E X).systemClosed.monoidal.associator
        ((pullbackTensorSequenceDerived l E f).obj M)
        ((pullbackTensorSequenceDerived l E f).obj N)
        ((pullbackTensorSequenceDerived l E f).obj P)).hom) :
    ∃ ε : (pullbackTensorSequenceDerived l E f).obj
        (pullbackTensorCalculus l E Y).systemClosed.monoidal.tensorUnit ≅
      (pullbackTensorCalculus l E X).systemClosed.monoidal.tensorUnit,
      ∀ M : coefficientSequenceDerived l E Y,
        ((pullbackTensorSystemComparison l E f).hom.app
          ((pullbackTensorCalculus l E Y).systemClosed.monoidal.tensorUnit,M) ≫
          (pullbackTensorCalculus l E X).systemClosed.tensor.map
            (Prod.mkHom ε.hom (𝟙 _)) ≫
          ((pullbackTensorCalculus l E X).systemClosed.monoidal.leftUnitor
            ((pullbackTensorSequenceDerived l E f).obj M)).hom =
        (pullbackTensorSequenceDerived l E f).map
          ((pullbackTensorCalculus l E Y).systemClosed.monoidal.leftUnitor M).hom) ∧
        ((pullbackTensorSystemComparison l E f).hom.app
          (M,(pullbackTensorCalculus l E Y).systemClosed.monoidal.tensorUnit) ≫
          (pullbackTensorCalculus l E X).systemClosed.tensor.map
            (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 _) ε.hom) ≫
          ((pullbackTensorCalculus l E X).systemClosed.monoidal.rightUnitor
            ((pullbackTensorSequenceDerived l E f).obj M)).hom =
        (pullbackTensorSequenceDerived l E f).map
          ((pullbackTensorCalculus l E Y).systemClosed.monoidal.rightUnitor M).hom)
